description.value:
Frequency once per day

You activate a sensor mask program installed in your body that distorts digital recordings of you. Select one of the following effects.

  • You become the target of a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Illusory Disguise] spell, except the illusory disguise is only visible to tech creatures, tech hazards, and tech visual sensors and recording devices (such as security cameras).

  • You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] to tech creatures, tech hazards, and tech visual sensors and recording devices (such as security cameras) for 10 minutes. You can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]].
